title: Sextette : Chi mi frena
other_titles: Lucia di Lammermoor. Chi mi frena in tal momento
summary: Vocal sextet (soprano, mezzo-soprano, 2 tenors, baritone, and bass), with orchestra
source_copy: Source of original recording: Recorded Sound Section, Library of Congress.
curator_note: The sextet from Donizetti's Lucia di Lammermoor, sung by a Metropolitan Opera ensemble led by Caruso; Victor sold it as a premium-priced disc.
